test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 01 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

The clothes will be delivered by the shop on Monday.

options.text: The shop will be delivering the clothes on Monday.
The shop will deliver the clothes on Monday.
The shop would be delivering the clothes on Monday.
The shop would deliver the clothes on Monday.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The shop will deliver the clothes on Monday.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the passive form and we need to change it into the active form.
 
• The given sentence is written in the passive form of the **Future Simple Tense**.
 
• The Future Simple Tense in the passive voice has the following structure: **Object+ will+ be +V3+ by + subject__**
 
• The Future Simple Tense in the active voice has the following structure: **__Subject + will+ v1+ object__**
 
• Example - 
 
 
• Passive voice - *The bag will be sewed by Kriya.*
 
• Active voice - *Kriya will sew the bag.*
 
 
 
• Rules of Conversion from Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle form of the verb.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct Active Voice: *The shop will deliver the clothes on Monday.*
